title: Huntik Foundation Jet
summary: Jets are used by the Huntik Foundation to transport their Seekers on their missions around the world. Despite the jets' lack of heavy weaponry, each one is equipped with a Power Amplifier that can amplify the magnitude and strength of Seekers' powers. Additionally, there is an auto-pilot feature as well as vertical take-off and landing modes.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
One of the Foundation jets was attacked by Caine and crash landed on a mysterious island, home to the wild Titan Polymaximus. [Island of the Titans]

The Huntik team arrives by jet at the Cloisters to help Focauld ward off the Blood Spiral. Dante explains the use of the Power Amplifier, which LeBlanche activates to help the team in a critical moment. [The Casterwill Connection]

One of the jets was attacked by the Blood Spiral after landing in Salon, before the team had the chance to get off. It was torn apart by Psikofen and exploded. [Words from Eathon]

full_text:
Jets are used by the Huntik Foundation to transport their Seekers on their missions around the world. Despite the jets' lack of heavy weaponry, each one is equipped with a Power Amplifier that can amplify the magnitude and strength of Seekers' powers. Additionally, there is an auto-pilot feature as well as vertical take-off and landing modes. 

==History==
One of the Foundation jets was attacked by Caine and crash landed on a mysterious island, home to the wild Titan Polymaximus. [Island of the Titans]

The Huntik team arrives by jet at the Cloisters to help Focauld ward off the Blood Spiral. Dante explains the use of the Power Amplifier, which LeBlanche activates to help the team in a critical moment. [The Casterwill Connection]

One of the jets was attacked by the Blood Spiral after landing in Salon, before the team had the chance to get off. It was torn apart by Psikofen and exploded. [Words from Eathon]
